t: An open pocket terminal with a keyboard, color screen, and long-range radio.
steps: Order Tanmatsu from the Nicolai Electronics shop and pick the right LoRa band for your region.
Turn it on and connect to Wi-Fi from the launcher.
Open the app repository and install the Meshcore app.
Install the MicroPython app and type a short program.
Read the Tanmatsu docs to learn the side ports and add-ons.
